meta.description: Run parameter sweeps over Proteina-Complexa design pipelines — cartesian-product hyperparameter scans, Pareto search over generation/reward/evaluation knobs, or any compare configurations workflow. Use when user wants sweep beam width, sweep nsteps, hyperparameter sweep, parameter scan, compare configurations, find best generation params, optimal nsteps, Pareto search for binder quality vs wall-clock, complexa sweep, tune Complexa, ablate reward weights, or run sweep YAMLs.

scientific_integrity.detail: Uses documented metrics; no fabricated results

practice_boundaries.detail: Computational sweep tool with no medical claims

methodological_ground.detail: Appropriate cartesian product methodology; Pareto frontier analysis scientifically sound

code_usability.detail: Bash loops syntactically correct; Python script invocations valid; multi-GPU sharding pattern correct

functional_suitability.note: Complete 7-step sweep workflow; handles canned and custom sweepers; multi-GPU sharding; Pareto frontier ranking; missing explicit failure recovery for partial sweeps

reliability.note: Preflight with cost confirmation, dryrun preview, error continuation in loop; lacks checkpoint restart for interrupted sweeps

performance_context.note: 219 lines with 2 reference files; inline sweep recipe table and multi-GPU code could move to references

agent_usability.note: Clear 7-step structure, canned sweeper table, sweep recipe recommendations; multi-GPU sharding adds complexity

human_usability.note: Good section headers, recipe table helpful; multi-GPU bash code dense; 219 lines requires scrolling

security.note: No credential handling needed; file paths validated; shell loop with error continuation safe; missing input validation for sweep YAML

maintainability.note: Good modularity with 2 reference files; version-tracked via manifest; canned sweepers reusable

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision; delegates to complexa-design for pipeline selection; cartesian product deterministic; manifest captures full replay; cost warning before execution

inputs.label: Beam width sweep with canned YAML

assertions.text: Output loops complexa design over generated configs
Output emits sweep_summary.csv with ranked configs
Output confirms GPU-hour cost with user
Output generates N configs via cartesian product
Output identifies best config by success rate
Output reports both best and frontier
Output shards config list across GPUs

assertions.note: Each design pinned to one GPU

assertions.text: Output skips failed config_id in ranking
Output provides guidance for resuming failed configs
assertions.note: No explicit re-run strategy for failed subset; user must manually identify and retry

assertions.text: Output clarifies no built-in live monitoring

assertions.note: User can tail logs or use external tools

assertions.text: Output detects override shadows sweep key
Output suggests removing override or sweep key

key_strengths: Complete cartesian-product sweep system with dryrun preview preventing wasted GPU time
Excellent cost awareness with N × M GPU-hour calculation and user confirmation before execution
Multi-GPU sharding pattern enables practical scaling on multi-GPU hosts with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES pinning
Pareto frontier analysis provides speed vs quality tradeoff insights beyond simple best-config ranking
Sweep recipe recommendation table maps symptoms to appropriate parameter axes

recommendations.title: Add partial sweep recovery guidance
recommendations.problem: One assertion failed: no explicit strategy for resuming failed configs in large sweeps. Reliability 2.3 scored 10/12. User must manually identify and retry failed inf_*.yaml files.
recommendations.root_cause: Error continuation with || echo FAILED allows sweep to complete but doesn't track failures for retry.
recommendations.fix: Add to troubleshooting or new section: To retry failed configs, parse FAILED output or compare ls configs/inference_configs/inf_*.yaml vs ls evaluation_results/eval_*/. Re-run: for cfg in <failed-list>; do complexa design $cfg; done. Alternatively, emit failed_configs.txt during sweep for easy retry.

recommendations.title: Move multi-GPU code to reference
recommendations.problem: Performance/Context scored 6/8; 219 lines with dense bash sharding code inline. Multi-GPU pattern is advanced and optional.
recommendations.root_cause: Multi-GPU section (lines 119-133) adds complexity to main workflow.
recommendations.fix: Move multi-GPU sharding pattern to reference/sweep_axes.md or new reference/multi_gpu.md. Keep only pointer in main SKILL.md: 'For multi-GPU parallelization, see reference/multi_gpu.md.' Target <180 lines.

recommendations.title: Add sweep YAML input validation
recommendations.problem: Security 6.2 scored 11/12; no validation that sweep YAML is well-formed before config generation. Malformed YAML could cause cryptic errors mid-sweep.
recommendations.root_cause: Delegates validation to generate_inference_configs.py at runtime.
recommendations.fix: Add Step 3.5: Validate sweep YAML structure before dryrun. Check: top-level is mapping, all values are lists or scalars, keys use dot notation. Prevents generate_inference_configs.py failure after user investment in authoring.
